sources.locator: Chapter 1 §§1.F-1.I (printed pp. 47-72, with §§1.F and 1.G read in full, and §1.H-1.I read for measurable fields, commutants and centres); Chapter 6 §§6.A-6.D (printed pp. 174-202) read in full for factor representations, central decomposition and type I; Chapter 7 §7.D (printed pp. 222-226) for ICC group factors; Chapter 8 §§8.D-8.F (printed pp. 253-259) for the sigma-compact to second-countable reduction, central characters, and the Glimm statement; §8.B, Definitions 8.B.1 and Remark 8.B.2, and Proposition 8.B.3 (printed pp. 242-243) for the maximal group C*-algebra and nondegenerate-representation correspondence; Appendix A.K (von Neumann algebras), A.B (standard Borel spaces), and A.C (Borel measures and sigma-finiteness) consulted for the cited back-references. Tables of contents and named theorem numbers were checked against the extracted text.; Chapter 1 §1.D, Proposition 1.D.3 (printed p. 40) states L1(G) separability for second-countable G without proving it; the dense-family construction is supplied locally; Appendix A.C, Theorem A.C.6, printed p. 409: for a Borel relation with everywhere-surjective projection and a standard Borel measure, it gives a Borel selector on a conull Borel subset and refers its proof to Mackey-76, Theorem Z.2, Chapter 2, §2.2. This item uses it only for comparison; its local nested-set proof gives all-point selections in the compact zero-set case.; Chapter 7 §7.A, Proposition 7.A.1 (ICC discrete-group factor criterion), printed pp. 213–214 (PDF pp. 212–213); Appendix A.E, Definition A.E.3 (ICC), printed p. 412 (PDF p. 411)
